environment: Synthetic Firestore and object storage; actual document and preparation services, ZIP writer, reader and import worker
checks: Selected documents carry readable current and historical snapshots with matching metadata and bodies. A crossing document is omitted as a whole; an independently selected task remains in the mixed package.
A repacked mismatched snapshot version is rejected. Undated observations or invalidated bodies are not silently selected.
Visit preparation uses its original calendar period and zone. A DST transition produces a 169-hour week and a 25-hour day. Removing one millisecond at either boundary excludes the item.
firstFailure: The preparation period case originally stopped with package_period_not_connected. The worker test initially asserted a resourceSection field that is intentionally absent on task results; the corrected assertion checks the recorded task resource.
limits: Local checks only. Per-document preview and manual overrides are separate work, and the original site has not been deployed.
